doc.title: Ann Rabson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 21, 2007

title: Opening and introduction of Ann Rabson
summary: Monk Rowe introduces Ann Rabson as one of the rare working musicians; she credits her manager.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: We are filming at Hamilton College for the Jazz Archive and I’m really pleased to have Ann Rabson with me today. And I will introduce you as one of the rare working musicians, I think, that I know.
Well most of the people I know, they play music but they also do a lot of other things. They teach or, you know, so congratulations on that.
Well congratulate my manager on that.
